data.notes: July 2026 is anchored by Starlite Occident’s international concert run, with Marbella Arena adding a compact electronic/house strand around mid-month.

events.title: Maroon 5 at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Maroon 5 headline Starlite Occident’s Auditorium on July 7, with the official page listing doors at 20:00 and showtime at 22:00.

events.title: John Legend at Starlite Occident
events.summary: John Legend returns to Starlite Occident on July 20, with the official event page placing the EGOT-winning singer-songwriter in the Auditorium at 22:00.

events.title: Juan Luis Guerra 4.40 at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Juan Luis Guerra 4.40 returns to Starlite Occident Marbella on July 15, with the official page highlighting his bachata and merengue legacy.

events.title: Jean-Michel Jarre at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Jean-Michel Jarre appears at Starlite Occident on July 13, with the official listing placing the electronic-music pioneer in the Auditorium at 22:00.

events.title: Diana Krall at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Diana Krall performs at Starlite Occident on July 21, with the official listing confirming the jazz pianist and singer for a 22:00 Auditorium show.

events.title: Kool & The Gang at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Kool & The Gang are confirmed for Starlite Occident’s Auditorium on July 23, with the festival presenting them as R&B, soul and funk legends.

events.title: Yandel Sinfónico at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Yandel brings his “Yandel Sinfónico” show to Starlite Occident on July 18, reworking his urban and reggaeton catalog with a symphonic format.

events.title: Manuel Turizo at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Manuel Turizo plays Starlite Occident Marbella on July 30, with the official page highlighting his Latin urban-pop repertoire including “La Bachata.”

events.title: Danny Ocean at Starlite Occident
events.summary: Danny Ocean performs at Starlite Occident’s Auditorium on July 4, with the festival billing him around hits including “Me Rehúso” and his contemporary Latin-pop catalog.

events.title: Faithless at Marbella Arena
events.summary: Faithless are listed by Resident Advisor for a live Marbella Arena show on July 9, with support from BL3SS and an 20:00–01:00 event time.

events.title: Certti at Mogli
events.summary: Friday Mogli pool-party residency built around Afrobeats, R&B, hip-hop and amapiano, with July dates confirmed for every Friday from 3 to 31 July.

events.title: Chris Stussy at Marbella Arena
events.summary: Chris Stussy plays a Marbella Arena open-air show on July 11, with Skiddle listing Laidlaw and Lauren Lo Sung on the lineup and house as the genre.

events.title: Afrobrunch at Mogli
events.summary: Afro-culture poolside Thursday residency at Mogli with July dates listed for 2, 9, 16, 23 and 30 July; the concept positions itself as one of Spain’s leading Afro music movements.

events.title: KISSTORY Marbella
events.summary: Major Sunday daytime pool-party brand at Nao Pool Club with confirmed July dates on 5, 12, 19 and 26 July, billed by the promoter as Marbella’s biggest pool-party/day-party event.

events.title: Josh Baker at Marbella Arena
events.summary: Josh Baker is confirmed by Resident Advisor for Marbella Arena on July 17, with house music listed as the genre and the event running 19:00–01:00.

events.title: Nueva Soul - The AfroHouse Rooftop Experience
events.summary: Sunday rooftop Afro-house series above Puerto Banús, with confirmed July dates including 5, 12, 19 and the DJ Sai Birthday Special on 26 July.

events.title: AfroBeast x Mogli
events.summary: Tuesday daytime Afro-inspired pool party at Mogli, advertised with Afrobeats, amapiano, hip-hop and Afro-house across its summer 2026 run.

events.title: R&B Lovers x Mogli
events.summary: Wednesday throwback R&B pool-party residency at Mogli, focused on 90s and 00s R&B anthems in a daytime pool-club setting.

events.title: The Red Cup Party at Tibu
events.summary: Thursday-night TIBU residency through summer 2026 with a Hip-Hop, R&B, Afrobeats, UK and Bashment soundtrack; July dates are listed for 2, 9, 16, 23 and 30 July.

events.title: Bad & Boujee at TIBU Marbella
events.summary: Puerto Banús urban club night at TIBU with Hip-Hop, R&B, Afrobeats and commercial party anthems, running late from Friday 24 July into Saturday morning.
